hints.title: Suspicious Reachability Component
hints.text: Run breadth-first search from method k to identify all methods directly or indirectly invoked by k.

hints.title: External Invocation Check
hints.text: Check all invocation edges (u, v). If an edge exists where u is not suspicious but v is suspicious, no methods can be removed.

hints.title: Filtering Output
hints.text: If no external invocation enters the suspicious group, return all non-suspicious methods. Otherwise return all n methods.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: BFS explores reachable nodes in O(V + E). Edge inspection takes O(E) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated full graph searches per node cause quadratic slowdown.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory for adjacency list and visited boolean array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models method dependency as a directed graph reachable component with boundary cross-edge verification.
